restaurants.name: Greenwood Fish Market Bistro
restaurants.description: The seafood specialist’s first mall bistro, with oysters, pasta and sharing plates. The official page announces the opening date; check current service before making a trip.

restaurants.name: Petra
restaurants.description: Mezze, fresh breads, seafood and grills in a garden setting at Dempsey. A new option for a long lunch or dinner with friends.
restaurants.hours: Lunch 11.30am–3pm; dinner from 5.30pm. Listed until 11pm Fri–Sat, 10.30pm other service days. Tuesday service isn’t listed—check before going.
